Commentary.Commentary: The umpires are out in the middle followed by the players of both sides. Muneeba Ali is accompanied by Sadaf Shamas for Pakistan Women. It will be Katherine Brunt to open up proceedings for England Women.
...CHASE BEGINS...

Right then, Pakistan Women have Mount Everest to climb and looking at the way they performed with the bat against West Indies Women, it looks only a matter of time before they suffer yet another defeat. Still, in cricket, anything can happen. Stay tuned...

Danni Wyatt (59 off 33 balls) comes up for a quick word. The English opener says she really enjoyed batting out in the middle and shares that the wicket is terrific for batting. Adds that this is the way they want to play going ahead in the tournament. She mentions that the team is looking to come out all guns blazing right at the top and just be a bit sensible in the middle with which deliveries to smash and which to respect. She closes by saying that it is a really good total and a lot of credit goes to Natalie Sciver as it seems she is looking at the cricket ball as big as a beach ball and smashing them all over the park for fun.

There is nothing to write home about Pakistan Women's bowling which was out-and-out poor. Every bowler suffered and looked clueless. 124 runs came in the last ten 10 overs and that tells us about the carnage that was created.

We have witnessed carnage with the bat! The only reason to bat first was to gain some batting practice and England Women will be more than satisfied with this outing. They set a tempo at the beginning despite losing two wickets and the pair of Danni Wyatt and Natalie Sciver took it forward. Both batted with a lot of class and freedom to raise a quickfire stand and after the departure of Danni Wyatt, it was the turn of Amy Jones to partner Natalie. They hammered 95 runs together at an outstanding rate and steered England Women to the highest-ever total in ICC Women's T20 World Cup.

OUT! A wicket goes down on the final ball. Slower one, on a length around off, Amy Jones turns and heaves it across the line. Her shot though lacks the desired power and Tuba Hassan takes a juggling catch at deep mid-wicket. England Women end of an imposing 213 for 5.
Commentary.Howout: c Tuba Hassan b Fatima Sana

Commentary.Commentary: Full and wide around off, Amy Jones drives this to extra cover for nothing.
Full and around middle, Amy Jones clubs this straight down the ground for a couple. Partnership clocks 100 runs with this couple.
FOUR! This is getting out of control for Pakistan Women. Overpitched around middle, Amy Jones makes room and lofts his over the infield on the off side for a boundary towards cover.
Full toss outside off, Natalie Sciver smashes this towards long on for a single.
FOUR! Bread and butter stroke for Natalie Sciver. Fuller around off, Natalie Sciver scoops this wide of the keeper for a boundary towards fine leg.
Flatter outside off, Amy Jones shuffles and looks to play across the line but misses out. 10 from the over!
Short and wide outside off, Amy Jones punches this wide of extra cover for a couple of runs.
Fuller going down leg, Amy Jones looks to sweep but misses out as the ball hits her pads.

SIX! No respite from either end as Amy Jones has slogged this out of the park for a maximum. Short in length around middle, Amy Jones smacks it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum. 200 comes up, the first-ever in the ICC Women's T20 World Cup!
Short in length around middle, Natalie Sciver smashes this to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short in length around middle, Amy Jones cuts this to point. Slight misfield and they run a single here.
Change in bowling. Nashra Sandhu (3-0-29-0) to bowl the penultimate over.
Full and wide outside off, Amy Jones slices this through the channel at the point. Muneeba Ali chases this all the way to the boundary and saves one run for her team as they run three.

FOUR! This is hitting at its very best from England Women. They are making a mockery of the Pakistan Women's bowlers. Full toss around the middle, Amy Jones sweeps this fine for a boundary towards the square leg region.
Tossed up around off, Natalie Sciver advances down the track to push this for a single towards long on.
FOUR! Different angle for the bowler but she suffers the same fate. Fuller around the middle, Natalie Sciver paddles this fine wide of short fine leg for another boundary.

FOUR! Natalie Sciver is surely eyeing her century here with the way she is attacking the Pakistan Women's bowlers. Her 10th boundary of the game as she sweeps the fuller delivery for a boundary down to fine leg.
Full and wide outside off, Amy Jones eases this over extra cover for three runs.
Flighted around middle, Amy Jones slogs this to deep mid-wicket for a single. 14 from the over!
Fuller around off, Amy Jones looks to reverse again but misses out.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for the English side here. Full toss around middle, Amy Jones accepts the freebie and dislodges this one bounce over the fence at the deep mid-wicket region.
FOUR! Reward for the risk-taker here as Amy Jones reverses this for a boundary. Fuller around off, Amy Jones reverse-sweeps and connects well to earn a boundary towards third man.
Tossed up in the line of the stumps, Natalie Sciver slogs this to deep mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Natalie Sciver is toying with the fielders. A boundary on the first delivery of the over and the pressure piles up on Nida Dar. Full around middle, Natalie Sciver sweeps this towards the square leg region for a boundary.
Change. Nida Dar (3-0-33-1) is back on.
Flighted and on middle, Amy Jones paddles this to short fine leg for none.
Short in length around off, Natalie Sciver punches this to sweeper cover for a single.

SIX! This is turning out ugly for Tuba Hassan. Natalie Sciver is in a ruthless mood right now. Tossed up around off, Natalie Sciver walks down the track and lifts this over the long off fence for a maximum.
FOUR! Short in length, dragged down a bit, Natalie Sciver clubs this for yet another boundary towards the square leg region.
FOUR! Natalie Sciver brings up her half century with a boundary towards cow corner. Tossed up around middle, Natalie Sciver slogs this towards the cow corner for a boundary.
Tossed up outside off, Amy Jones lofts this to long on for a single. Nashra Sandhu should have gone for the catch here but she took a step back and allowed the ball to drop in front of her.
Plays a length ball down to covers for a single. 18 from the over!
Full in length and outside off, Jones goes for a big heave but misses.
Another beamer! On middle, Jones tries to heave but misses. The bowler is continuing and Natalie Sciver is not happy with the decision. Two beamers are not allowed. Free Hit to follow.
5 Penalty runs awarded to England Women.

A low full toss on middle, Amy walks across the stumps and scoops it wide of short fine leg for a couple. The throw comes to the keeper who collects but then it slips out. There was a discarded piece of equipment on the field (the keeper's outer gloves) and the ball touched it. Five penalty runs.
Back of a length outside off, Jones goes deep inside the crease and thumps it down the ground. Two runs taken as the long on fielder cuts it off.
Beamer! Fatima Sana serves a high full toss and it's a no ball. Around off, Jones tries to pull but misses and takes a blow on the waist line of her trouser. Free Hit to follow...
Slower one, full and around off, Natalie knocks it down to long on for a run.

FOUR! Connects and connects nicely. Full and around middle, angling down, Natalie Sciver bends her back knee and whips it past short fine leg for a boundary. The fielder inside the ring should have done better.
Sana bowls it full and on middle, Jones works it to deep square leg for a single.
Fatima Sana (2-0-20-1) comes back into the attack.
Goes on the back foot and punches it to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Poor delivery and punished! Short in length, around off, Amy Jones goes down and smashes it towards square leg. The fielder there misfields as the ball spins past her to the fence.
Beaten again! Googly from Tuba. Outside of and turning in, Jones tries to drive but is beaten on the inside edge.
Play and a miss! Full and outside off, turning away, Jones tries to sweep but misses.
Short outside off, cut to cover-point.
Fuller and outside off, forced down to long off for a single.
On middle, helped to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Bang! Short and on middle, Natalie Sciver goes on the back foot and pulls it powerfully to the deep square leg fence.
Just over! Flighted and full, down the leg side, Jones tries to sweep but gets a top edge. It flies just over short fine leg and they cross.
Nida Dar (126 wickets) becomes the leading wicket-taker in Women's T20Is with this wicket of Heather Knight. Meanwhile, Amy Jones walks out next.

OUT! CAUGHT! Two wickets in quick succession for Pakistan Women. Tossed up around off, fuller in length, Heather Knight gets down to sweep but is a bit early into the execution of her shot. The ball flies off the lower half of the blade and as a result, it doesn't have enough wings to clear the fielder in the deep at square leg. Nashra Sandhu settles underneath it and makes no mistake near the fence.
Commentary.Howout: c Nashra Sandhu b Nida Dar

Commentary.Commentary: Short and around off, turning in, Sciver goes back and punches it past the extra cover fielder for a run.
Full and flighted, around off, Knight reverse-sweeps it towards short third man for a run.
Nida Dar (2-0-25-0) comes into the attack.
Extra flight on this delivery, full and on off, Heather Knight pushes it softly with an angled bat to short third man. Natalie Sciver calls her partner for a quick run.
Wide! Flighted again, outside off and spinning further away, Heather leaves.
Short again, outside off and staying low, Knight crouches a bit and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Short and outside off, Knight tries to pull but ends up mistiming it back to the bowler.
Flighted and full, around off, defended to the off side.
Heather Knight walks out to replace the half-centurion Danni Wyatt.

OUT! Danni Wyatt holes out! A wicket against the run of play for Pakistan Women. The dangerous 74-run stand has been broken. Floated delivery, full and around middle, Wyatt tries to go aerial again and targets the boundary downtown. She though fails to execute her shot. The ball spins a bit at the point of contact with the blade and flies straight down the throat of Sidra Ameen at long off. A fine knock from Danni is over but she will be disappointed to not make a huge score.
Commentary.Howout: c Sidra Ameen b Tuba Hassan

Commentary.Commentary: Loopy and full, around middle, Wyatt jumps down the track and drags her attempted heave to deep mid-wicket. Gets two runs.
Tuba Hassan continues.
Short and wide outside off, Natalie walks across the stumps and hammers it towards cow corner for two runs. 16 from the over, England Women are marching!
Deft! Short and around off, Wyatt stays back and guides it down to short third man for a run.
SIX! High and long! Full toss around off, Danni Wyatt is in the mood. She gets on top of the bounce and smashes it over square leg for a biggie. 100 comes up!

FOUR! Superb placement! Full and flighted, wide outside off, Danni Wyatt shuffles across the stumps and powers it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary. Fifty for Danni Wyatt, a timely arrival to form for her!
Fuller and around off, Danni walks forward and lifts it over extra cover for a brace. She is batting beautifully today.
Short and on off, Sciver goes back and pulls it against the spin to deep mid-wicket for a single.

Drinks break. Steady going for England Women. They lost a couple of wickets but that didn't affect their scoring rate. Both Danni Wyatt and Natalie Sciver are looking in fine touch and the English team will be relieved to have Danni among the runs before the knockouts. Pakistan Women are bowling without much planning and looking clueless at the moment. If this continues, they might end up chasing a massive target.
Fuller outside off, Natalie Sciver drills this to long off for a single. England Women are 89 for 2 at the halfway mark.
Gives it a bit more air around off, Natalie Sciver punches this towards long on and they run a couple. Good running by these two out in the middle.
A bit of turn and bounce for Tuba Hassan. Short in length on top of off, Danni Wyatt cuts this late towards short third for a single.
Fuller around middle, Natalie Sciver pushes this down the ground for a single.
FOUR! Things keep on getting better as Natalie Sciver keeps on showcasing her array of strokeplay. Tossed up outside off, Natalie Sciver uses her wrists to loft this over extra cover for as boundary.
Flighted outside off, Natalie Sciver drives this to the fielder at extra cover for none.
Flighted around middle, Natalie Sciver drills this to long on for a single to end the 9th.
Full and wide outside off, Natalie Sciver looks for a reverse sweep but for once fails to connect.
Short in length on top of off, Danni Wyatt cuts this sharp towards short third man for a single.
Full and wide outside off, Natalie Sciver slog-sweeps this to deep mid-wicket for a single. She was looking for the second but Danni wasn't interested.
Short in length around off, Danni Wyatt cuts this to sweeper cover for a single.
Tossed up around off, Natalie Sciver walks down the track to push this for a single at long on.

FOUR! Nida Dar has been put under some serious pressure from these two English batters. Full toss outside off, Danni Wyatt sweeps this fine, wide of the fielder at square leg, for a boundary. 12 from this over!
Full and around off, Danni Wyatt drives this to straight to the fielder at extra cover for no run.
A bit quicker around middle and leg, Natalie Sciver has slapped this towards deep square leg for a single.
Short in length around middle, Natalie Sciver milks this to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
FOUR! Natalie Sciver is attacking the Pakistan skipper here. Tossed up outside off, Natalie Sciver has driven this through extra cover for a boundary. A bit of flair is attached to this shot.
Loopy delivery outside off, Danni Wyatt has hammered this back to the bowler. Nida Dar deflects this off her foot for a single towards long off.
Despite an expensive first over, Nida Dar has decided to continue...
Full outside off, Natalie Sciver goes for a hunt as she looks to play across the line but misses out this time. 8 from the over!
On a flatter trajectory outside off, Danni Wyatt punches this to extra cover for a single.
Short in length around off, Natalie Sciver has punched this towards extra cover for a single.

FOUR! Natalie Sciver is in the mood as she walks across the stumps and picks up her spot with supreme confidence to dispatch this for a boundary. Flighted outside off, Natalie Sciver shuffles to across and sweeps this towards the square leg fence for a boundary.
Flatter and on middle, Danni Wyatt jumps back and cuts this to point. Misfield allows them a single.
Tossed up around off, Natalie Sciver pushes this gently towards long on for a single.
Powerplay is done and despite losing two wickets, England Women have scored 55 runs. Nashra Sandhu comes into the attack.
Short in length on top of middle, Natalie Sciver hammers this towards deep square leg for a single. Powerplay is done with England Women enjoying the better of it.
Full toss outside off, Danni Wyatt drives this toward covers for a single.
Short in length around off, Danni Wyatt threads this past point for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Up and over goes Danni Wyatt as she has found her magical touch it seems. Full outside off, Danni Wyatt chips this over the covers for a boundary.
Tossed up around middle, Natalie Sciver pushes this towards long on for a single.
FOUR! Natalie Sciver welcomes Nida Dar with a boundary through extra-cover. Juicy half-volley outside off, Natalie Sciver drives this through extra-cover for a boundary.

FOUR! A good end to the over for England Women! Full and flighted, around middle and leg, Danni Wyatt tries to sweep but fails to middle it properly. It takes the top edge and goes behind square leg for a boundary.
FOUR! Excellent shot! Loopy and full, around off, Danni Wyatt runs down the track again and goes inside-out over extra cover. Times it to perfection and the ball races away to the fence.
Flatter and outside off, Wyatt walks down the track and tries to punch but mistimes it back to the bowler, off the bottom edge.
Fuller and around off, skidding in, Natalie Sciver eases it through mid off for a single.
Natalie Sciver is the new batter out in the middle replacing Alice Capsey.

OUT! BOWLED! Sadia Iqbal gives it some extra toss and lands it very full around off, Alice Capsey goes down to slog across the line but the length is not ideal to play that shot. She misses and the ball goes on to disturb the stumps. Two wickets inside the Powerplay for Pakistan Women!
Fuller and around off, Alice reverse-hits it but finds the fielder at backward point.
Sadia Iqbal continues to bowl her 3rd.
FOUR! Cheeky! Length delivery around off, at 104 kph, Danni Wyatt stays back quietly and plays it at the last moment. Opens the face of her bat and guides it towards third man for a boundary.
Full and around leg, it's driven back to the bowler who dives and parries it to short mid-wicket.

Aerial but safe! Full and on middle, Capsey tries to flick but gets a leading edge. It balloons behind the bowler and Aliya Riaz, from mid off, rushes across to her right but it falls wide. She should have put in a dive. A single taken.
FOUR! Fine shot! Fuller in length, around middle and angling in, Alice Capsey clears her front leg and whips it over mid-wicket for a cracking boundary.
Sees the batter charging down the track and drags her length short, Wyatt pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short in length and outside off, Wyatt cuts it behind backward point for a couple of runs.
Fatima Sana (1-0-8-1) will continue here.
Arm ball around off, on the shorter side, Capsey gets back to pull but finds the fielder at mid-wicket.
Tossed up around middle, Wyatt defends it gently to covers and pinches a single.
Advances down the track and plays a mistimed lofted shot over mid on. It doesn't carry to the fielder in the deep and they cross.
Aerial but safe! Loopy and around middle, landing full and gripping a bit, Capsey tries to flick but it takes the leading edge. The ball falls safely at cover-point.
Fuller and around leg, Wyatt steps down the track and eases it towards mid on for a run.
Short in length and outside off, Danni goes back to cut but finds backward point.
Sadia Iqbal (1-0-10-0) will continue.
On one bounce! Pitches it up and around middle, Capsey drives it aerially and it goes on one bounce to mid on.
Slightly short, on middle and leg, Capsey walks forward and tries to work it on the leg side but misses. It hits her on the body and rolls back to the bowler.
Alice Capsey walks in next to join Danni Wyatt.

OUT! CAUGHT! Sana takes the pace off and delivers a full ball outside off at 105 kph, Sophia tries to go over mid on this time but it takes the bottom half of her bat and flies straight into the hands of Nashra Sandhu. She makes no mistake and England Women lose an early wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Nashra Sandhu b Fatima Sana

Commentary.Commentary: Beaten! Length delivery around off, Sophia Dunkley swings her bat at it but she does so on the wrong line.
Full and around off, Sophia presses forward and lofts it over mid off. The outfield is a bit slow and they get two runs. Dunkley is off the mark!
Back of a length, around off, Sophia slaps it down the ground but it goes on one bounce to mid off.
Angles in a length ball on off, Dunkley defends it from the back foot. The bowler has overstepped now. Free Hit to follow...

FIVE WIDES! Wayward start from Sana. A gentle loosener, on a length and way down the leg side, Sophia leaves and Sidra Nawaz, the keeper, only gets a gentle touch on the ball. It deflects off here gloves and goes to fine leg for a boundary.
Fatima Sana will share the new ball from the other end.
Fuller and around leg, Wyatt stays back and defends it to the off side. 10 from the first over.
SIX! This one goes all the way! Loopy delivery, full and around middle, Danni Wyatt again uses her feet and goes downtown. She connects well and sends it sailing over long on for a maximum.
FOUR! Finds the gap and opens her account! Tossed up around off, fuller in length, Danni Wyatt uses her feet and drives it crisply past the cover fielder for a boundary. England Women are also away!
Gives it some extra air and keeps it full around off, Wyatt drives but finds the cover fielder.
Floated delivery, full and on middle, Danni Wyatt plays it with soft hands to short mid-wicket.
Flighted delivery, full and on middle, Danni defends it on the surface.

All in readiness now! The players concerned are out in the middle. Danni Wyatt and Sophia Dunkley are the openers for England Women. Sadia Iqbal will bowl the first over but before that, both teams take a knee to support the BLM movement. Here we go...
Bright and sunny conditions out there! The players from both teams have lined up for their respective national anthems. Pakistan's first and it's followed by the anthem of England.

Pakistan Women (Playing XI) - Sadaf Shamas (replaces Bismah Maroof), Muneeba Ali, Omaima Sohail, Nida Dar (C), Aliya Riaz, Sidra Ameen, Fatima Sana, Sidra Nawaz (WK) (Replaces Aiman Anwer), Nashra Sandhu, Tuba Hassan, Sadia Iqbal.

England Women (Playing XI) - Danni Wyatt, Sophia Dunkley, Alice Capsey, Natalie Sciver, Heather Knight (C), Amy Jones (WK), Sophie Ecclestone, Katherine Brunt, Charlotte Dean, Sarah Glenn, Freya Davies (replaces Lauren Bell).
TOSS - England Women have won the toss and they have decided to bat first.

The battle between the pacers of England Women against the top order of Pakistan Women could well decide the course of this game. Pakistan Women need to be wary about the scoring rate in the Powerplay as a slow start could bring back the memories of that intent-less inning against the West Indies.
Update - Bismah Maroof has a niggle and will be missing this game. Nida Dar will be leading Pakistan Women in this match.

On the other hand, Pakistan Women are already out of the semis with just 1 victory in 3 games. They will be playing this game for pride as they have nothing to lose now. The defeat against West Indies Women acted as a knockout punch to them in which they failed to chase down 116. Apart from the centurion Muneeba Ali and that knock of 68 from the bat of skipper Bismah Maroof against India Women, there haven't been any standouts from the batting outlet for them. Can they punch above their weight this time around? Stay tuned for more updates...

England Women have had an amazing run so far as they have managed to dominate their opponents and ended up on the winning side in all three games played so far. The last win was a big one as they defeated India Women to cement their place at the top of Group B. The form of Natalie Sciver is what has given the English side a massive edge as she has been amongst the runs and has bowled really good lines and lengths so far. On the contrary, the form of Danni Wyatt is a concern for them as she has scored just 27 runs in the tournament so far. The English team will be hoping that she strikes for this evening.
The group is already decided and this is a dead rubber but it has a lot at stake in terms of momentum for England Women while it's a matter of finishing the campaign with pride for Pakistan Women

Hello and welcome to all our viewers, we are all set to bring all the ball-to-ball action of Match 19 of the ICC Women's T20 World Cup game between the unbeaten England Women against Pakistan Women. It looks like a lopsided contest but if the Asian unit sorts out its batting, we could get a close game.
...MATCH DAY...

England Women will go head-to-head against Pakistan Women in Match 19 of the ICC Women’s T20 World Cup, 2023 at Newlands in Cape Town. England have won all their games and already sealed a place in the semis, whereas, for Pakistan Women are knocked out following the win of India Women. The English team played its last game against India where despite a sluggish start, they came out victorious with the help of a brilliant knock from Natalie Sciver and other batters in the middle order. They posted a total of 151 which proved to be a bit too much for India Women, who fell short by 11 runs. England Women are clicking up at the right time in all three departments with contributions from the top order and middle order, along with the bowlers. On the contrary, Pakistan Women squared off against West Indies Women in their last match and lost a game that they should have won. Inconsistency amongst the batters is something that has cost them a place in the semis. The battle between the bowling unit of Pakistan and the star-studded batting unit of England is something to look forward to. Let's hope for a close match.
